title: Exact true ORIGINAL D6 fixed-point-map global right-injection expected count
statement: For every s=2^h>=8 and every fixed complete globally injected ORIGINAL point mapping f, let N_left_C6_AA(f) count genuine SIX-DISTINCT-INCIDENCE Q with six distinct point factors and SIX distinct original line factors whose fixed physical left projection yields a simple connected coordinate C6. For ONE uniformly random complete globally injected ORIGINAL right-line mapping g, E_g[D6(f,g)|f]=((a)_6/(K)_6)*N_left_C6_AA(f), K=C(a,2)>=V minimal, V=(s+1)(s^2+1). The same g is reused across all Q, never sampled independently per Q.

quantifiers.domain: any fixed complete original point globally injected unordered physical-pair map
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original line physical-pair map, shared across ALL original Q

external_dependencies: Exact original seven-family positional D6 criterion on six identical original incidence IDs from AA4-Q.
Finite combinatorial uniform six-label marginal of ONE complete globally injected right map.
limitations: A positive E_g D6 for every f does NOT imply positive D6 for every pair f,g.
No assumption of independent D6 indicators for different Q with the SAME g.
No unconditional simultaneous two-sided minimax lower is proved.
falsification_boundary: Count only true six original incidences with six distinct source point and source line factors, and align connected ORIGINAL COLUMN physical C6. The distribution is a single complete globally injected g.
